_notes: Machine Account Classification for a Microsoft Entra source (UI: Machine Accounts → Classification, "Enable Classification" + "Customize classification"). Accounts matching either group are classified as machine accounts, and each gets a machine identity unless it is correlated to a human identity. Group 1: managed identities (managedIdentity_type); group 2: service principals (spn_servicePrincipalType Application or Legacy). Same criteria a UI-configured source shows by default (2026-10-08). Applied by `isc-source.sh classification` as PUT /v2026/sources/{id}/machine-classification-config (GA); `--process` then runs POST /v2026/sources/{id}/classify (the UI's "Process Classification") so already-aggregated accounts are classified too. Keys starting with _ are stripped before sending.
